## The defect

Independence was inferred from row counts, never declared. A mirror
republishing another source's rows read as an independent observation —
copied data corroborated its original. And a bare upstream id carried no
namespace: two sources' coincidentally-equal local ids (`ref = "101"`)
read as one upstream row — the camera-site resolver's tier-1g shared-ref
rule, and any identifier-equality join, merged across undeclared
namespaces. `derived_from_claim_ids` was declared at the typed-assertion
layer but never persisted per claim, so derivation ancestry was
unrecoverable. SIG-CONF-014's guarantee — independent corroboration
counts only across genuinely independent lineages — was not true on the
spine.

## What ships

- **Declared source lineage (registry).** `sources.toml` rows carry
  additive `kind` (`primary`/`mirror`/`derived`/`syndicated`/`undeclared`),
  `origin`, `mirror_of`, `derived_from`, `independence_class`
  (`src:<source-id>`/`ext:<slug>`/`unclassified`) and `id_namespace`.
  `connectors/src/connectors/lineage_declarations.py` + `registry.py`
  validate fail-closed: dangling lineage refs, self-references, invalid
  kinds/classes/namespaces, and unfounded mirror declarations all reject.
  `assert_loadable` is untouched — lineage metadata never changes
  `ingestion_permitted` or the loader gate. Declared rows: `osm_overpass`
  + `deflock_repo` primary; `camreg_osm_surveillance` derived from both —
  `unclassified`, because it combines two upstreams without per-target
  lineage splitting (an honest default, never fabricated).
- **`sig.id-namespaces/1` — the committed namespace vocabulary**
  (`db/src/db/data/id_namespaces.toml` + `db/src/db/lineage.py`):
  shared spaces (`osm.element`, `deflock.node`, `dot_511`) plus per-source
  private `src:<source-id>`; a token outside the vocabulary fails closed.
- **Sqitch `declared_lineage`.** `source_lineage` — the versioned,
  immutable registry mirror `(source_id, registry_version)`;
  `source_lineage_current` — the latest declaration per source;
  `claim_lineage` — **one row per claim**: `source_id`, `id_namespace`,
  `lineage_kind`, `independence_class`, `basis`, `derived_from_claim_ids`
  (SIG-EPIS-009 persisted at emit), `recorded_at`. Unknowns are explicit
  non-null tokens (`undeclared`/`unclassified`) — never NULL read as
  independent. UPDATE/DELETE triggers refuse; grants stay least-privilege:
  ingest SELECT+INSERT, materialize INSERT, restricted/export SELECT —
  **`sig_read_public` widened zero** (the exact §37 allowlist stands).
  The `assertion_quarantine` reason CHECK widens to the full predecessor
  union plus `unknown_id_namespace`.
- **Emit-time lineage.** `PgClaimSink` inserts each new claim's
  `claim_lineage` row in the claim transaction (`ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`
  — replays stay idempotent). A per-claim `id_namespace` override binds
  only inside the committed vocabulary; anything else quarantines
  `unknown_id_namespace` — never silently namespaced.
  `derived_from_claim_ids` persists verbatim on derived claims.
- **Namespace-qualified identity.** `CameraRecord.id_namespace` reads from
  the ref claim's lineage row (a per-claim override wins over the source
  default); the tier-1g shared-ref auto-write fires **only inside a
  declared shared namespace** — a mirror carrying its upstream's ids
  declares `dot_511`; equal bare refs in different or undeclared
  namespaces never join; `undeclared` never equals `undeclared` as shared
  evidence. `infer_lineages` seeds the declared-class map
  (`source_lineage_current`) and emits the GQ-11 copy-disclosure finding
  for undeclared shared-class unions.
- **Independence-aware reconcile + export.** `reconcile` reads declared
  `independence_class`: corroboration counts across declared-independent
  classes only; a mirror and its original are one disclosed voice;
  `unclassified` is disclosed, never weighted independent. Export
  observation envelopes disclose `n_independence_classes` and
  `n_unclassified_candidates` — additive counts, the published basis is
  inspectable.
- **`sig-db lineage-rematerialize`** (`db/src/db/lineage_rematerialize.py`
  + CLI): mirrors the committed declarations into `source_lineage` and
  back-populates `claim_lineage` for claims lacking a row — source
  resolution through `claim_evidence → evidence_capture →
  evidence_artifact.source_id`, ancestry copied from persisted
  `derived_from_claim_ids`, explicit `undeclared`/`unclassified` where
  resolution is absent or ambiguous (**no lineage is ever fabricated**).
  Dry-run by default; `--apply`, `--limit`, `--batch-size`; keyset-ordered
  and resumable; `+0` on rerun — INSERT-only, never UPDATE/DELETE.
- **API-basis disclosure (S6 A-20, staged).** `SIG_API_BASIS_NOTICES`
  (JSON array or `;`-list) lands `basis.notices` on API answers — absent
  key when unset; release/live-spine basis labels unchanged. The
  `/status/` sentence is staged in copy batch 02 `ST-11` (**pending**
  operator confirmation; `data-copy` marker on `status.astro`), sha256
  `c751850d6b030f04c86b887026d5e42fc97e0d4341668d31b5c3afec02f17573` —
  never shipped as pending copy.
- **ADR-213** records the decisions + deviations.
